title: Guide 5. How to Edit Public Pricing Page (the /join page)
text:
## Guide 5. How to Edit Public Pricing Page (the /join page)
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000068749
By default, all sites come with a default Join page that can be accessed using the " yoursite.com / join " URL and through the Main Menu link on the Homepage:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119661696/original/Ycuc8aMZQE3L1tgSjHmoQSvbwAE67nXoxw.png?1673369037 | alt: ]
Through this page, encourage the website visitors to join the site with a Join page that feels personalized and properly synced to the site.
A page that is easy to use and easy to read and that clearly directs users to click on the best plan for them is what we recommend.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119676045/original/33N6nnyJ1WT0ixxa6hl2_7NYXYGPoiIDng.png?1673384400 | alt: ]

## Checkout Forms
Selecting the " Click to Join Now " button will redirect them to the /checkout pages. The only difference between these pages is when it comes to the forms; FREE and PAID.
GDPR for these pages can be enabled/disabled inside Settings » General Settings » Configuration: User Consent Tools (GDPR Compliance)

## Free Plan Form
This form will only ask for Email (username) and Password.
The /checkout pages will display the Membership Plan name automatically.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119980063/original/4TuGigo12A7OvPlB2rnBPtuq57laEG2cDg.png?1673970194 | alt: ]

## Paid Plan Form
This form will ask for Email (username) and Password and the Credit Card information if the website is using an On-site Payment Gateway like Stripe .
If the website is using an Off-site Gateway like PayPal it will redirect the user to the site to complete the payment.
Additional Information:
» Stripe or PayPal Standard?
» Supported Payment Gateways
This form shows the checkout process using Stripe:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119980175/original/9qQeH7CRkRjU7IgnLrbbUs2z-VylXkrx6A.png?1673970297 | alt: ]

## Off-Site Payment Gateways
This form shows the checkout process using PayPal Standard:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119980796/original/1JjKVZl46jHhl8nALa6w9NLzrBxlRVPxsA.png?1673970888 | alt: ]
The user is redirected off the site to complete the payment.

## Join/Pricing Web Page
This page can be found inside Content » Edit Web Pages » Pricing Page :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183124517/original/gZ63a-I6N96dAmNqhUXmemt1VorRbfWBVw.png?1785870710 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183124747/original/lmzvUockQiZjWx3KFuVQnqF_EeDAEqQNHQ.png?1785870946 | alt: ]
The first three items on this image can be edited to fit the site:
1. URL  ( best to leave as is )
2. Page Title (H1)
3. Sub Title (H2)
4-7 . These tabs are for adding custom text, CSS, HTML and Footer content. Edit the Hero Section of the page accordingly:
» How to add a Hero Section on Static Pages
There are two additional widgets that can be used on the page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183124833/original/ZFD-38G_HnbBkRFLtqd0kJxr6CV6mFE4Yw.png?1785871021 | alt: ]
8. The Claim Listing add-on, it requires a subscription: Claimable Business Listings . If this add-on is not enabled, this will not display on the site. This widget will only appear for anyone going through the claim a listing process.
9. Side by Side pricing widget displays the membership plan tables inside the Pricing Page menu on the site.
» Side-By-Side Pricing Tables » Introduction
10. This is where the information for each plan can be edited.
11. These are the Pre Made Elements: Web Page Builder » Pre-Made Elements
Additional Information:
» To read more about the Web Pages, follow this link: Web Pages Folder
» For more about the Widgets, follow this link: Toolbox » Widget Manager

## Edit Checkout Button
The " Click to Join Now " button will show different options where the link can be edited when clicked on. Find the " Edit Link " button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119983425/original/MUNPZ6zLAk2HGbLmxaq1wu0MHuJAEXDw5g.png?1673973239 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119983470/original/TMnn68Abb-Svdjm4529OTPKEWRmKKZ8X6Q.png?1673973261 | alt: ]
The number at the end of the " /checkout/X " URL is determined by the plan ID:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183124873/original/3Xw04ioNOC_azptNdK6TGTQtMXuetaipAA.png?1785871092 | alt: ]
Extra text and images can also be added inside the WYSIWYG editor and the content will appear on the Join Page.
Additional Information:
» Everything About WYSIWYG Editors
» How to Post Images On WYSIWYG Editors
This page also comes with divider tables to provide equal spacing between the plans:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12119983767/original/Ua90zodguw8hqaglxxHKThlAkhSScjFOug.png?1673973528 | alt: ]

Use the Pre-Made Elements to add additional pricing tables to the page:
